heroHeadline: FDA Approves Updated COVID-19 Vaccines Targeting Dominant XFG Variant
heroSubtitle: The FDA authorized updated COVID-19 vaccines targeting the XFG variant on August 27, launching the 2026-2027 vaccine season. Outgoing DNI Tulsi Gabbard released declassified documents on June 18 alleging Fauci suppressed lab-leak intelligence; independent reviews dispute the claim. WHO's IGWG PABS annex outcomes have been pushed to the 2027 World Health Assembly.
